name: ardoise
description: Hosted Ardoise usage status and spend statements via MCP. Usage only; no prompts.

ARDOISE_API_TOKEN.title: Ardoise CLI token
ARDOISE_API_TOKEN.description: ard_… token minted at hosted /app/settings. Used as Authorization for /v1/usage/status and /v1/usage/statement. Never commit this value.

ARDOISE_API_URL.title: Ardoise API origin
ARDOISE_API_URL.description: Hosted API origin. Leave unset to use the production default.
